notes: Implemented all four security improvements for the signing path: (1) token entropy upgraded from UUID v4 (122 bits) to 32-byte random hex (256 bits) in generate.ts and autoGenerateDocuments.ts; (2) signing token no longer returned to patient portal for signed documents; (3) conditional UPDATE (compare-and-swap) in patchConditional prevents TOCTOU race on concurrent signing; (4) audit log entries written on signing via writeAuditLogToSupabase scheduled from action.
